purpose: Warn of a bad result if a state or behavior continues.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
If we keep waiting for a reply, we will not make it in time.
If you keep working late every night, your health will not hold up.
If we keep doing nothing but complain, nothing will change.
restrictions: Often predicts trouble from continued behavior.
mistake: Do not use it as a neutral positive conditional without context.
